needed.evidence: Informal path under 1m obstructed with trip hazards
needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous, purpose-built sidewalk of at least 1m width along the left side of the road.

needed.evidence: Informal path obstructed by parked cars or other objects
needed.suggestion: Ensure the path on the right side is kept clear of obstructions and install barriers to prevent vehicles from parking on the footway.

needed.evidence: Broken or uneven sections on the informal path
needed.suggestion: Repair and even out the informal path on the left side to eliminate any tripping hazards.

needed.evidence: Broken or uneven sections on the informal path
needed.suggestion: Repair and even out the informal path on the right side to remove any tripping hazards.

needed.evidence: Pedestrians crossing at a location without a marked crossing facility
needed.suggestion: Install a formal marked zebra crossing with clear, highly visible stripes to facilitate safe pedestrian crossings.

needed.evidence: Crossing is obstructed and not clearly visible for drivers
needed.suggestion: Improve the marked crossing with an advance stop line, better visibility enhancements, and ensure it is well-maintained and unobstructed.

needed.evidence: No dropped kerbs facilitating pedestrian crossing
needed.suggestion: Install dropped kerbs at the pedestrian crossing to provide a smooth transition from footway to carriageway, aiding accessibility and safety.
